question: _______are the greatest option for experts due to their durability and flexibility.
solution:
The correct answer is __Bi-metal blades**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bi-metal blades__ are highly durable and flexible, making them ideal for expert use.
 
• They are designed to combine the toughness of high-speed steel with the flexibility of spring steel.
 
• This combination ensures excellent performance and resistance to breakage under stress.
 
• Bi-metal blades are suitable for cutting through tough materials like metal, wood, and plastic.
 
• Their longevity reduces the need for frequent replacements, saving costs in the long run.
 
• These blades are widely used in industrial, construction, and professional settings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **High-carbon steel blades:**

 
 
• These blades are known for their hardness but can be brittle.
 
• Best suited for cutting soft materials like wood and plastic.
 
 
 
• **Fine-toothed blades:**
 
 
• Ideal for precise cutting tasks and achieving smooth finishes.
 
• Commonly used for metal and fine woodworking.
 
 
 
• **Coarse-toothed blades:**
 
 
• Designed for fast cutting through thick materials like wood.
 
• Not suitable for fine or detailed work.
